# host-election

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: Which mounted root host of a page-global service runs: useElectedHost(service) — for a `scope: "each"` root host whose engine is ONE per page (a hints tour, the background music), mounted at the page root and in every `<PluginScope>`. Every mounted host registers under its service; exactly one is elected: the page's when the page holds the plugin, else the first scope's (the standalone website, which holds the plugin only for its demo's scope). A static render registers nothing and elects no one.
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by:
    - `hints`
    - `music/background`
- Web:
  - Exports (values): `useElectedHost`
